facts.fact: 他想象她穿着那身裙子在伦敦沙龙里与人争辩，也想象她走在自己身边
facts.anchor: He could imagine her in some literary salon in London

facts.fact: 真穿上裙子她走两步就绊，他扶住她的手肘
facts.anchor: The real woman could barely walk without tripping over the layered skirts

facts.fact: 他用粤语背情诗，音调一个没错；她板着脸，耳根却红透
facts.anchor: No other waters can impress me, for I have seen the ocean

facts.fact: 她说两尊守门石狮该朝外守门，不该面对面
facts.anchor: The lions should not be facing each other.

facts.fact: 他劝她别爬栏，说狮子只是闹着玩——话说出口才知说错
facts.anchor: It’s just a lark, they aren’t really providing protection.

facts.fact: 她挑了「特里斯坦」这匹马
她伸手捂住他的嘴，问他这故事要讲多久
facts.anchor: Is this story going to take long?

facts.fact: 她走后他偷偷把手贴到自己唇上，闻到香与烟的味道
facts.anchor: he surreptitiously touched his own hand to his lips

facts.fact: 他押独赢，赔率五十比一
他被人撞倒，晕过去前听见有人喊他起来
facts.anchor: That was the last thing he remembered.
